storySteps.title: Question Euric, reveal the workshop, and free Smiler
Feed Smiler and finish his introductory questions
Repair the soul extractor, healer, and portal
Bring Euric oil and open his hidden room
Restore Euric's room and recover Gerry's tooth
Return Gerry's lost tooth
Report the restored room to Euric
Inspect and restore the church's stained-glass window
Build the first working soul container
Purchase the second sin technology and receive Smiler's question
Ask Smiler whether souls can heal humans
Ask Euric whether souls can heal humans
Return to Smiler and unlock the human healing station
Build the human healing station beside the soul healer
Optionally add the pride extension to the soul healer
Question Smiler after building the human healing station
Ask Horadric about Euric and open the next Euric lead
Ask Euric how to obtain a glorious ode
Have Vagner write the ode directly
Mail Vagner an ink pen and commission the ode
Wait exactly 450 seconds for Vagner's reply
Receive Vagner's ode and choose whether to send money
Give Bishop the ode and a sin shard
